description.short_caption: Axial pelvic CT scan showing soft tissue and bony structures.
description.detailed_description: This axial pelvic CT scan demonstrates the bony pelvis, soft tissue structures, and surrounding musculature. The image is taken without visible contrast enhancement. The central pelvic cavity is visible, with symmetrical iliac bones and soft tissue densities. No obvious abnormalities such as masses, fractures, or fluid collections are apparent in this image.
visible_findings: soft tissue structures in the pelvic cavity

description.short_caption: Hematoxylin and eosin stain showing fungal elements in tissue.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image, stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), reveals fungal elements within tissue. The fungal structures are highlighted by arrowheads and appear as round to oval yeast forms with a thick capsule. The surrounding tissue shows evidence of inflammation and necrosis. An inset magnifies a region with clearer visualization of the fungal morphology.
visible_findings: round to oval yeast forms with thick capsules
background tissue showing inflammation and necrosis

description.short_caption: Silver stain of prostatic aspirate showing fungal elements.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a silver stain of a prostatic aspirate. The background is stained light blue, and numerous darkly stained, round to oval structures are visible, consistent with fungal elements such as yeast forms. The silver stain highlights the fungal cell walls, making them appear black against the blue background. The distribution of the fungal elements appears scattered and clustered in some areas.
visible_findings: darkly stained round to oval fungal elements
scattered and clustered distribution of fungal forms
